After you upload the wedding photo at checkout, our design team reviews it and enhances it for engraving clarity - sharpening detail, balancing exposure, simplifying busy backgrounds where helpful. We convert the photo into a 3D model that maps to the heart geometry. The 4K laser leaves microscopic refractive points at exact depths inside the K9 glass, forming the wedding portrait with lifelike volume. You can layer the portrait with text - couple names, wedding date, ceremony location - via Special Instructions at checkout. Our design team mocks up the layout before production starts. What photo works best The heart favors close, intimate framings - the bride-and-groom portrait, the first-kiss moment, the first-dance shot, the candid in the garden after the ceremony. Clear, well-lit professional wedding photos in JPG or PNG format (ideally 2,000 px on the long edge or larger) give the sharpest engraving. Wide-angle ceremony shots and group photos don't engrave as well as close portraits. Plain or softly-blurred backgrounds engrave with more depth than busy ones.
